title: PRISM: PRior-guided Imagination Sampling in world Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.07974v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Latent world models learn representations that enable them to predict how actions change the environment - a capability we call physical intuition. We find that these same representations also support action intuition: a lightweight head can learn a goal-conditioned action prior directly from the frozen encoder's features. We introduce PRISM to investigate how action intuition can be extracted from frozen world-model representations and used to guide goal-conditioned planning. The prior's mean and predicted uncertainty guide the search for useful actions, while the world model evaluates their consequences against the goal. Experiments on four simulated control tasks and two real-robot platforms show that a lightweight action head improves planning performance, and that the same fusion interface accepts a diffusion prior over the same frozen features without modification. translated_title: PRISM：世界模型中先验引导的想象采样
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型所学习的表征能够预测动作如何改变环境——我们将这种能力称为物理直觉。我们发现这些相同的表征还能支持动作直觉：一个轻量级网络头部可以直接从冻结编码器的特征中学习到目标条件化的动作先验。我们提出PRISM，以研究如何从冻结的世界模型表征中提取动作直觉，并将其用于引导目标条件化规划。该先验的均值和预测的不确定性用于引导搜索有用的动作，而世界模型则对照目标评估这些动作的后果。在四个模拟控制任务和两个真实机器人平台上的实验表明，轻量级动作头能够提升规划性能，并且同一融合接口无需任何修改即可接受作用于相同冻结特征之上的扩散先验。这些结果展示了复用世界模型表征的潜力。
tldr: 该论文提出PRISM框架，通过一个轻量级动作头从冻结的世界模型表征中提取动作先验，以其均值和不确定性引导目标条件化规划，在模拟与真实机器人任务上均提升规划性能，且同一融合接口无需修改即可兼容扩散先验。
en_tdlr: PRISM extracts a lightweight goal-conditioned action prior from frozen world-model representations, whose mean and predicted uncertainty guide planning, improving performance on simulated and real-robot tasks while allowing a diffusion prior to plug into the same fusion interface without modification.
